title: What Languages Sound Like To Foreigners
summary: Finnish YouTuber Saara improvises gibberish that mimics how various languages sound to people who do not speak them. The sentences are mostly made up, and the clip went viral.
why: HN points to it as a favorite example of astonishing accent mimicry and fake-language gibberish that sounds real.

quote.text: Internet personality Saara turned speaking fake languages into a career with this amazing little clip
